title: Restriction of extension by zero on an open is the identity
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and U an open subset. Let E be the extension-by-zero module presheaf functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf] followed by module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], and R the restriction functor of [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. There is a natural isomorphism E followed by R to the identity functor on sheaves of modules on the localized ringed site over U.

proof.text: Choose the exact adjunction E left adjoint to R. For a sheaf G on U, transport its unit G to R(E(G)) along the equivalence from module sheaves on the slice to module sheaves on the open subspace. Forget to abelian sheaves.

At any x in U, take the interior stalk isomorphism e and its germ formula from lem-sc-module-extension-by-zero-stalk-maps. Stalk hom extensionality and the restrictionStalkIso_hom_eq_germ formula identify the stalk map of the unit followed by the canonical restriction-stalk isomorphism with the underlying abelian map of e. Thus the unit induces an isomorphism on every stalk.

Apply Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso. Reflect isomorphisms through SheafOfModules.toSheaf and the equivalence. All unit components are isomorphisms, so the unit is a natural isomorphism; take its inverse. For empty U the stalk criterion is vacuous; for total U the same proof applies.
